title: MESA
description: A desert themed texture pack, greatly inspired from the mesa update from peak !
body:
The Mesa [16x] is a texture pack made around summertime and mainly based around the deserts and mesas, as the name suggest.


It's a green pvp texture pack made for 1.8.9 bedwars but can be used overall in other pvp gamemodes.


It takes a great inspiration from Peak's Mesa Update while also keeping the desert theme itself.


Here are some ingame screenshots of the texture pack :



![Mesa 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0660cb7fcdb103deb279e294b269ce4a91ff96ea.jpeg)

![Mesa 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36ee901cb4b858dc11c74d4c51864557c6449455.jpeg)

![Mesa 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/566cfa0be9c558daecdc07b147d9615b7bc3d921.jpeg)


Sidenote : Feel free to join the discord if there is any issues with the Texture pack (Rendering Issues, Crashes, Textures not working properly, Sky glitches and/or not rendering...) It helps us greatly improve the work we do and provide the best for you all !
